relevance_note: The paper describes four novel GAMT-deficiency patients, e.g. 'a 6-year-old male with a homozygous pathogenic variant in the GAMT gene', plus a table of 45 literature cases.
method_note: Tables 1 (4 own cases, labels 'Case 1'-'Case 4' from the 'Authors' column, as used in the Case presentation headings) and 2 (45 literature cases; no label column, so 'Table 2 row k'; the 'Authors' cell is copied into source_reference_in_review) were transcribed by a Python script that parses the Markdown rows and builds row-prefix spans; output was checked against the tables. Both table titles define '+/−' as presence/absence, so U+2212 '−' cells are 'excluded' with the legend quoted as second span. Two cells use an ASCII hyphen '-' (Table 2 row 34 Behavioral abnormalities; row 42 Hypotonia); the legend defines only '−', so these were left not reported. Empty cells (row 31) and 'NA' are not reported. Checklist mapping from the table: Seizures -> seizures or epilepsy; Intellectual disability or Developmental delay '+' -> developmental delay or intellectual disability observed (excluded only if both '−'); Hypotonia -> hypotonia; Autism '+' -> autistic features observed, but Autism '−' leaves autistic features not reported (narrower absence). 'Movement and tone disorders', 'Behavioral abnormalities' and 'Atypical symptoms' are composite and map to no checklist item; they are recorded as phenotypic_features rows only. Normal brain MRI (Cases 1, 2) and 'no structural etiology' (Case 3) were recorded as excluded 'abnormal brain MRI'/'structural brain abnormality' only; MRI checklist items left not reported. 'Restricted language development' (Case 2) and 'lack of expressive language' (row 9) were taken as absent or limited speech; plain speech delay was not. ADHD -> hyperactivity observed. Discussion facts were added only for literature persons who map to one Table 2 row unambiguously (rows 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 13, 20, 34). Not mapped (ambiguous): the Caldeira female 'presented at 5 months ... diagnosed at the age of 19' (row 12 has onset 5 months, row 14 age 19); the Hinnell Turkish female 'at the age of 25 ... When she turned 31' (rows 17 and 18 may be one person shown twice; not merged); the Leuzzi 2000 [38] cerebellar findings (rows 36, 41); group sentence citing refs 9,26,33,34,35. Literature variant rows: Table 2 gives only zygosity words ('Homozygous', 'Heterozygous', 'Hemizygote'/'Hemizygous') with no variant description, so variant_original_string is 'not reported'; zygosity recorded as stated even though 'heterozygous'/'hemizygous' is odd for an autosomal recessive disease. Contradictions: Table 2 row 7 (Stern) Autism '−' vs Discussion 'seizures, autism, intellectual disability' (both rows kept; checklist autistic features not reported); Table 2 row 20 (O'Rourke) Intellectual disability '−' vs Discussion 'Her intellectual disability was severely affecting her learning' (both rows kept; checklist DD/ID observed from the uncontested Developmental delay '+'); rows 2-3 Developmental delay '−' while Discussion says 'they showed signs of intellectual delay'; row 4 Intellectual disability '−' vs 'cognitive ... delay'; Case 2 Behavioral abnormalities '−' while ADHD is reported; Case 4 Intellectual disability '−'. Case 3 onset is '4' in Table 1 (Age of onset (years)) while text says speech delay was noticed 'at the age of 2 years'. Case 1 protein printed 'p.D135 h' in text and 'p.D135h' in Table 1; Case 3 cDNA printed 'x. 577c>T' (not a c. string) so cdna_hgvs_as_stated is null. Case 4 sex from Table 1 'Male' and text 'he'; Case 4 pathogenicity not stated (Table 1 omits 'pathogenic'). Case 4 variant type 'missense' from 'predicted to result in an amino acid substitution'. Discussion calls the Aydın pair 'Two siblings', while reference 20's title says 'two cousins'; no family label recorded. Out of scope: Case 1's 'other two siblings are healthy' (untested, unaffected) and Case 2's 'cousin with epilepsy' (no GAMT testing or diagnosis stated) get no rows. n_patients_reported null: the paper states 4 novel cases and 45 literature cases but never a combined total; cohort_size_as_stated is the 45 included literature cases (53 retrieved). Age columns in Table 1 have headers 'Age (years)' and 'Age of onset (years)', so the bare numbers there are years.
